about: Daily job watch for the curriculum site. Written by the pulse-pull Action from signed relay payloads; seeded 2026-10-21 from the manual search.

jobs.title: Academic Emergency Medicine Physician (pool ad)
jobs.employer: UC Irvine School of Medicine, Dept. of Emergency Medicine
jobs.fit: The only live posting built for a July 2027 start, at the institution where you already lead RUAIH and run Workflow #35 in production.
jobs.gap: The ad lists no informatics duties. The AI medical director share has to be funded by the health system and negotiated separately. UC's compensation plan limits outside clinical work (UCSD's EM ad says moonlighting is barred), so check what UCI would allow for your S-corp shifts.
jobs.note: Opened Aug 21, 2026. Final date Jun 30, 2027. Checked today.

jobs.title: IT Consultant V, Medical Informatics Physician, SSD
jobs.location: San Diego; remote within KP states, ~10% travel
jobs.fit: A completed CI fellowship meets the minimum. Three years of AI work is preferred. Full time, M–F.
jobs.gap: No clinical time. This req will probably fill before July 2027.
jobs.note: Posted Apr 28, 2026. The posting page still takes interest as of Oct 21, but it no longer turns up in KP's own job search and one job-board copy says it's closed. It may be closing.

jobs.title: Chief Clinical Informatics Officer
jobs.fit: The closest content match found: leads evaluation and governance of generative AI, predictive, ambient and CDS tools on Epic. Formal informatics training meets the bar.
jobs.gap: A C-suite title for a new graduate, being filled now. Reports to the Chief Technology Product Officer.
jobs.note: No posted date. Apply button live. Checked today.

jobs.title: Associate CMIO (Assoc./Asst. Clinical Professor)
jobs.fit: The exact title and split you want: four days informatics, one day clinical.
jobs.gap: Requires 4+ years of progressive physician leadership. Prefers Oracle Health experience, not Epic.
jobs.note: Posted Jun 3, 2025. Apply still live as of today. Recruiter copies are still running: Prosum lists it as “ACMIO, Digital and Data Innovation” at $300K–$350K, and Jobot calls it contract-to-hire.

jobs.title: Associate Medical Director, Clinical Efficiency and Value
jobs.fit: Throughput, appropriateness and value work, with CI, CDS and order-set experience preferred. Maps to your boarding and charge-capture QI.
jobs.gap: Asks for 5 years post-training; you'll have 4 in July 2027. Not AI-specific.
jobs.note: Posted Apr 24, 2026. No closing notice. Checked today.

jobs.title: National Medical Director, Clinical AI Innovation and Performance
jobs.fit: The duties are your skill set: LLM annotation for UM decisions, precision and recall readiness reviews, governance from shadow mode to production, and clinical lead for the foundation-model teams.
jobs.gap: Requires significant UM and InterQual operations leadership. For-profit.
jobs.note: Posted Aug 11, 2026. Can close early. Checked today.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Context Engineer
jobs.fit: Half the job is writing medical guidance and prompts for its AI doctor, and 30% is building evaluation frameworks for diagnostic accuracy, treatment appropriateness and prescription safety. The closest vendor match to your gold-set work.
jobs.gap: For-profit. Wants a data-science and database background, and prefers urgent care, primary care or IM.
jobs.note: Published Jan 14, 2026 and still listed. Checked today.

jobs.title: Principal Clinical Content – Physician (Clinical AI Strategist, UpToDate)
jobs.location: Remote, or hybrid from a WK office (Torrance is one)
jobs.fit: Clinical test sets, benchmarks, safety evaluation and expert testing for UpToDate's AI, plus outcomes studies with partner health systems. Up to 20% clinical time is allowed.
jobs.gap: Asks for 5+ years of clinical practice; you'd be borderline. About 20% travel. For-profit.
jobs.note: Reposted about Oct 8, 2026 at Principal level. Checked today; listed as expiring Nov 17, 2026.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Specialist, AI Systems
jobs.fit: Designing clinical AI evals and rubrics plus hallucination and medication-safety checks, with end-to-end ownership across teams. Nearly an exact match for your validation work.
jobs.gap: For-profit. The posting leans toward functional or preventive medicine expertise.
jobs.note: Reposted about Oct 17, 2026 after being taken down Oct 8. Over 100 people have clicked apply. Checked on LinkedIn today.

jobs.title: Physician Informatics Executive
jobs.fit: Federal and commercial Oracle Health EHR deployments, including VA work. Your VA Long Beach shifts give you a view of the VA Oracle rollout.
jobs.gap: About 80% travel and US citizenship with a security clearance. Prefers 10+ years total and Oracle (Cerner) experience. For-profit.
jobs.note: Reposted about Oct 14, 2026. Checked on LinkedIn today.

jobs.title: Associate CMO, Acute and Post-Acute Care
jobs.fit: Enterprise clinical operations across hospitals: hospital medicine models, handoffs, care transitions, length of stay, readmissions. Close to your transfer and boarding work, and an est. 60/40 admin/clinical split.
jobs.gap: Asks for progressive physician leadership in a multi-hospital system; prior ACMO or medical director experience preferred. A big stretch now.
jobs.note: Posted Sep 22, 2026. Extended deadline Nov 2, 2026. Checked today.

jobs.title: Physician AI Engineer
jobs.fit: Owns clinical and safety AI agents end to end and builds the clinical eval framework that sets the quality bar. Published LLM-evaluation work is preferred.
jobs.gap: Requires hands-on production LLM building and owning shipped products. Your UCI platform should count, so be ready to show it. For-profit.
jobs.note: Now on Counsel's own job board; updated about Oct 8, 2026.

jobs.title: Physician Informatician (MD required)
jobs.fit: Written for a CI-fellowship graduate: Epic workflow and launch experience, Python and SQL, NLP, FHIR/HL7 and coding vocabularies.
jobs.gap: The work is mostly interoperability and data modeling, less evaluation. For-profit.
jobs.note: Updated Jan 29, 2026. Apply live. Checked today.

jobs.title: AI in Medicine Research Faculty
jobs.employer: Cedars-Sinai AI in Medicine Research Center
jobs.fit: Applied clinical AI research at a 501(c)(3), which suits your JAMIA and NEJM AI pipeline.
jobs.gap: Requires leading an independent research program. No ED clinical role is stated.
jobs.note: Posted Feb 20, 2026. Apply live.

jobs.title: Emergency Medicine Physicians (full-time, per diem, virtual)
jobs.location: Downey, Woodland Hills, OC, South Bay, Panorama City, San Diego and others
jobs.comp: $362,375–$461,055 FT + up to $59,556 premium · sign-on up to $75K · per diem up to $240/hr
jobs.fit: The highest clinical pay found, and it gets you inside Kaiser. A 100% virtual EM role at $140/hr was also posted Oct 8.
jobs.gap: No informatics time.
jobs.note: Standing recruitment. SCPMG's own job portal showed about 20 EM openings on Oct 21, including Orange County, Los Angeles, West LA, Downey, Panorama City, Woodland Hills, Baldwin Park, San Diego and a South Bay nocturnist slot.

jobs.title: Emergency Medicine Clinical Faculty
jobs.location: UCLA West Valley and Santa Monica-UCLA, onsite
jobs.fit: A UC faculty job in LA for July 2027. Fellowship training and scholarship count in your favor.
jobs.gap: Clinical only. Any informatics role would be a separate negotiation with UCLA Health.
jobs.note: Opened Aug 7, 2026. Final date Jan 31, 2027. Checked today.

jobs.title: Surveyor, Hospital MD
jobs.location: Remote, US. 100% travel while on duty; live near a wide-body airport (LAX qualifies)
jobs.fit: An inside seat at the organization that runs RUAIH certification. The 0.48 FTE option fits around EM shifts.
jobs.gap: Requires 2 years of leadership or management and CPHQ by the end of 2028. Low pay and heavy travel.
jobs.note: Posted Aug 8, 2026. Updated Aug 26. Six openings, hired in recurring orientation classes. Checked today.

jobs.title: Associate Medical Director, Physician Advisor for UM
jobs.fit: A 0.5 FTE option fits around EM shifts. The patient-status work overlaps your boarding and billing projects.
jobs.gap: Not informatics.
jobs.note: Posted May 26, 2026.

jobs.title: Physician Advisor / UM Medical Director
jobs.employer: Providence Little Company of Mary (Torrance) and Providence Cedars-Sinai Tarzana
jobs.fit: The top of the physician-advisor pay range found. Overlaps your patient-status, documentation and billing work.
jobs.gap: Requires 3+ years of medical group management. Not informatics.
jobs.note: No posted date. As of Oct 21 neither role shows on Providence's own job site, so they may be filled.

jobs.title: Clinical Associate Physician – Emergency Medicine (51%)
jobs.fit: The posting asks for demonstrated quality improvement and leadership, which matches the ED Trigger Tool work Los Alamitos is leading with you.
jobs.gap: 64 hours a month, clinical only.
jobs.note: Live on UCI's job portal. Checked today.

jobs.title: Clinical Assistant Professor of EM (Clinician Educator, part-time)
jobs.employer: Keck Medicine of USC – Verdugo Hills Hospital
jobs.fit: USC faculty title with community-site shifts and teaching. A foot in the door at Keck, where the ACMIO role sits.
jobs.gap: Part-time and clinical only.
jobs.note: Posted Jun 17, 2026. Apply live as of today.

jobs.title: Emergency Physician at UCI Health – Lakewood, plus Vituity Physician Leaders Fellowship
jobs.location: Lakewood ED; fellowship hosted at any Vituity site
jobs.fit: Vituity staffs the ED at a UCI Health network hospital, so this keeps you inside the transfer network. The fellowship runs about 2.5 admin days a week toward an ED medical director role.
jobs.gap: For-profit partnership, so PSLF would stop. No informatics.
jobs.note: Lakewood listing on PracticeMatch, undated. Fellowship page is live with no 2027 cohort dates yet.

jobs.title: Medical Fellow, Human Frontier Collective
jobs.fit: Designing clinical scenarios and grading model safety, with an option to co-author papers with Scale's research team. EM is named. The publication option makes it the best side role found.
jobs.gap: Pay isn't posted. Board certification required.
jobs.note: Updated Oct 6, 2026. Apply live, reviewed on a rolling basis. Checked today.

jobs.title: Medical Doctor, Physician Expert
jobs.fit: The highest hourly rate found. IM, FM and EM preferred.
jobs.gap: Seen only on an aggregator. Includes a 25-minute AI interview.
jobs.note: Posted Oct 6, 2026 (aggregator copy).

jobs.title: Physician, Emergency Medicine (LLM training)
jobs.fit: The best-paying EM-specific evaluation work found: writing EM scenarios and grading model reasoning.
jobs.gap: 20–40 hours a week, with at least 4 hours a day overlapping Pacific time. Too heavy during fellowship except in a vacation block.
jobs.note: Shown as posted Oct 10 on Remotive. Checked today.

jobs.title: General Clinician (MD/DO), AI evaluation
jobs.employer: Weekday, for an unnamed AI client
jobs.fit: Rubric writing, hard test cases and safety grading. EM backgrounds preferred.
jobs.gap: A 20-hour weekly minimum, and the client isn't named.
jobs.note: Posted Sep 17, 2026.

jobs.title: Medical Expert (MD/DO), standing pool
jobs.fit: Fellows accepted. EM-specific projects come out of the pool and have paid $150–$170/hr.
jobs.gap: Project by project, with no guaranteed hours.
jobs.note: Pool listing posted about a month ago.

jobs.title: Physician (MD/DO), Medical AI Evaluation
jobs.fit: Flexible hours.
jobs.gap: Focused on general medicine, and uses little of your evaluation-design skill.
jobs.note: Posted Oct 9, 2026.

jobs.title: Medicine expert (EM listed)
jobs.fit: Lists clinical informatics as a bonus qualification.
jobs.gap: Generic task work.
jobs.note: Evergreen page with no date.

jobs.title: Physician (VISN 22 CRH Tele-Emergency Care Director)
jobs.location: Remote, plus some in-person ED shifts
jobs.fit: EM, tele-ED and multi-facility leadership in your own VA region, about 80% administrative, with informatics desired. You already work VA Long Beach shifts.
jobs.note: A 120-day detail that ran Nov 18–28, 2025, now closed.

jobs.title: EM Administration Fellowship (2027–28 cycle)
jobs.employer: UC Irvine Dept. of Emergency Medicine
jobs.fit: An existing department vehicle for funded ED administration time.
jobs.gap: Junior rank; you'd be overqualified as a trainee.
jobs.note: Last year's ad (JPF09853) ran Sep 2025 to Apr 2026. The 2027–28 ad hasn't posted yet.

jobs.title: ED Medical Director
jobs.location: California Hospital Medical Center (Dignity), downtown LA
jobs.fit: A full ED operations leadership role in LA.
jobs.gap: Requires prior medical director experience. For-profit group.
jobs.note: Live on the USACS site, undated.

jobs.title: Medical Director I (continuous)
jobs.employer: LA County Department of Health Services
jobs.fit: County medical director roster with high public-sector pay.
jobs.gap: Requires 2 years of medical administrative experience.
jobs.note: Continuous posting open since Aug 2023.

jobs.title: National Medical Director, Episodic Care & Enterprise Safety
jobs.fit: EM preferred, with AI-enabled care pathways and enterprise safety. One of the closest remote matches seen.
jobs.gap: For-profit.
jobs.note: Posted Jun 13, 2026; now closed. A sister Virtual Urgent Care medical director role (EM preferred) is also closed.

jobs.title: AI team (Director, AI and Impact Science; Senior Manager, Emerging Technologies and AI)
jobs.fit: A public health plan building an AI evaluation and governance team in LA.
jobs.gap: Neither posting is a physician role.
jobs.note: Director role posted Jan 15, 2026, probably filled; the senior manager role is on L.A. Care's board.

jobs.title: Emergency Medicine Physician (Clinical Informaticist)
jobs.fit: A public safety-net system hiring exactly the EM-plus-informatics hybrid you want.
jobs.gap: Outside your geography.
jobs.note: Posted about 2 weeks ago on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Physician Informaticist
jobs.fit: A clinical AI documentation company based in Los Angeles.
jobs.note: Regard's job board shows no openings now.

jobs.title: Director, AI and Digital Health (non-physician)
jobs.fit: Leads evaluation and testing of AI-enabled and EHR-integrated software, with acceptance criteria tied to clinical workflows. That is your validation work.
jobs.gap: Asks for 10+ years of evaluation or test leadership. Pay is below physician level.
jobs.note: Posted about 8 days ago (aggregator copy).

jobs.title: Senior Physician Executive (Solution Design)
jobs.fit: A commercial clinical lead who works with CMIOs and CIOs. Your Abridge configuration work is directly relevant.
jobs.gap: Sales-facing, with heavy travel.
jobs.note: First seen Aug 3, 2026. I couldn't confirm it's still open.

jobs.title: AI Associate, MD
jobs.fit: LLM evaluation and red-teaming.
jobs.note: Taken down May 4, 2026.

jobs.title: Chief Health Informatics Officer (CHIO)
jobs.location: Long Beach, West LA, San Diego (none open now)
jobs.fit: The VA posts CHIO roles often, and they usually stay open only 1–3 months. VA Long Beach and Greater LA both filled informatics chief roles in 2023, so these seats turn over.
jobs.note: No SoCal openings. The Fresno CHIO closed Sep 30, 2026.

jobs.title: Chief Medical Informatics Officer
jobs.fit: Allowed up to 0.25 FTE clinical.
jobs.note: Expired. Posted Jun 13, 2025.

jobs.title: Emergency Medicine Faculty (informatics preferred)
jobs.employer: UC San Diego Dept. of Emergency Medicine
jobs.fit: Listed informatics as a preferred background.
jobs.note: Closed Sep 22, 2026.

jobs.title: Director, Responsible AI (non-physician)
jobs.fit: The work is your RUAIH work: AI intake, risk review, governance committees and vendor due diligence.
jobs.note: Live, no posted date.

jobs.title: Clinical AI Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco, in office 3 days a week
jobs.fit: A very close skill match: evals, error analysis, prompting, and managing about five clinical AI staff.
jobs.gap: Outside your geography. Asks for 3–5 years at a tech company.
jobs.note: Live. Checked today.
